observation.command:
cd /workspace/tests/data && python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/tmp/httpd.log 2>&1 &
SRVPID=$!
sleep 2
cd /workspace && timeout 550 python3 -m poetry run python dcat_catalog_check.py --url http://localhost:8000/catalog.ttl > /tmp/results.jsonl 2>/tmp/check_stderr.log
EC=$?
kill $SRVPID 2>/dev/null
echo "SCRIPT_EXIT=$EC"
echo "---stderr tail---"
tail -5 /tmp/check_stderr.log
echo "---results count---"
wc -l /tmp/results.jsonl
echo "---all lines valid JSON?---"
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
good = bad = 0
lines = open('/tmp/results.jsonl').read().splitlines()
for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
    obj = json.loads(line)  # raises if invalid JSON
    if obj.get("num_good_checks", 0) > obj.get("num_bad_checks", 0):
        good += 1
    else:
        bad += 1
print(f"valid JSON lines: {len(lines)}, good-leaning: {good}, bad-leaning: {bad}")
EOF
